title: Likes and dislikes
subtitle: Me gusta, no me gusta
review: Written by Claude in Latin American (Mexican) Spanish. Check the Spanish, the English and the notes before recording audio. English support only.

categories.desc: Liking one thing, several things, and doing something.
cards: Me gusta + one thing. Literally 'coffee pleases me'.
Me gusta el café sin azúcar.
Me gustan los tacos al pastor.
Stronger than me gusta. For things and activities, not for people.
Me gusta + a verb: always gusta, never gustan.
Me gusta mucho bailar, pero bailo muy mal.
I really like dancing, but I dance very badly.

categories.desc: From a soft no to a firm one.
cards: No goes first: no me gusta.
I don't like it at all.
No me gusta nada levantarme temprano.
I don't like getting up early at all.
— Do you like spicy food? — Not really.
I don't like him. / I don't like her.
For people: me cae bien (I like him), me cae mal (I don't).

categories.desc: Asking what someone likes, and saying what you prefer.
cards: There's red and green. Which one do you prefer?
After a negative: a mí tampoco, me neither.
— Me gusta el mole. — A mí también.
Mexican. Padre: great, cool. Stronger: ¡qué padrísimo!
— I'm going to Oaxaca. — How cool!
